correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the exact local selected-neighbor test including twisted seam, the weight-preserving 16-state trace, and the commuting flip decomposition into dimensions 10 and 6. An executable exact symbolic determinant calculation validates Qplus and Qminus in the actual submitted checker. Formal Newton trace identities prove every coefficient; filtering by top z-degree proves degree at most n, and positive Lucas-form coefficients prove degree exactly n for all n>=3. Exhaustive brute force at 3..10 rungs, a separate sparse DP at 3..32, and Lucas check at 3..100 support but do not replace the unrestricted proof.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: A familiar transfer matrix for the untwisted ladder can have determinants Qplus and Qminus in a product, but the Möbius result requires proving which factor lives in each swap eigenspace and subtracting signed contributions. Neither the product of determinants nor any cited theorem alone implies the signed ratio or periodic optimum count.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The three descriptions are mathematically equivalent by complementing selected vertices, so all were considered. Inspected statements report general algorithms/complexity rather than the all-weight Möbius enumerator. Search absence alone is not a proof of novelty.

evidence: The inspected 2023 and 2024 primary full texts present bounds and rectangular-grid matrices, not a coefficient table for the Möbius ladder. Direct exact enumeration through 10 rungs provides a computational cross-check, not a literature-database novelty certificate.
exact_database_or_table.reasoning: No table directly covering the signed Möbius coefficient sequence was located. No reliance is placed on a negative database search as definitive proof; exact mathematical implication comparisons are primary.

originality.rationale: The finite signed-trace identity enumerates all dissociation sets of every size for the nonorientable Möbius ladder, whereas the closest inspected primary results concern complexity, upper bounds for all cubic graphs, open rectangular grids, and inclusion-maximal dissociation sets. An untwisted cycle-prism result does not determine the required signed trace without the flip action. Searches of one-dependence and 3-path-cover aliases found no stronger covering theorem; residual earlier-equivalence risk is expressly retained.
residual_risks: An equivalent Möbius-ladder one-dependence or induced-degree-one enumerator might be buried under alternate notation in earlier graph-enumeration work.

Full text of Tian–Tu (2024) and Kardoš–Katrenič–Schiermeyer (2011) was not inspected; the available primary/abstract statement differences are strong but do not prove absence of ancillary Möbius calculations.
The nearby untwisted prism dissociation enumerator uses related determinant factors, making careful novelty framing necessary: only the new signed seam and its distribution are asserted.

value.rationale: A nontrivial signed boundary classification supplies all graded dissociation counts for every Möbius ladder and the exact Lucas-plus-divisibility multiplicity of optimum P3-covers. This is a natural constrained-induced-subgraph problem on a classic cubic family; the Möbius flip changes full graded counts rather than only a cosmetic graph label or an arbitrary finite order, and the result cannot be obtained from global cubic bounds or untwisted determinant products without a new swap-eigenspace calculation.
